## Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened (include console error logs, network panel failures, or database logs if applicable).

## Screenshots / Video Recordings
If applicable, add screenshots or recordings to help explain the problem.

## Environment Details
- **User Role**: (CUSTOMER | OWNER | ADMIN | Unauthenticated)
- **Browser & OS**: (e.g. Chrome 124 on macOS Sonoma, Safari on iOS 17)
- **Node Version**: (e.g. Node v20.x, Node v22.x)
- **Database/Prisma Version**: (e.g. Prisma v6.19)

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. Cashfree vendor setup status, R2 upload state).
